title: [wish] bluetoothsignal strength
line: The Bluetooth widget's device details now show the signal strength, like Wi-Fi networks do.
explanation: The Bluetooth widget never showed signal strength, although BluezQt already exposes each device's RSSI to QML. BlueZ only reports RSSI while the adapter is discovering (for example while the Add Device wizard is searching) and drops it afterwards; connected devices get no RSSI over D-Bus at all. The change adds a "Signal Strength" row to the expanded device details whenever an RSSI is known, converted to a percentage with NetworkManager's Wi-Fi mapping (-100 dBm = 0%, -50 dBm = 100%), and keeps it updated while the details are open.

commits.message:
applet: show signal strength in device details

The applet gave no way to tell how far a device is, unlike Wi-Fi in the
network applet. The device details now show the signal strength as a
percentage whenever BlueZ reports an RSSI, which it does while scanning.

BUG: 478431

media.caption: Master: a paired speaker seen at -62 dBm while scanning; its details show no signal strength
Patched: the same details now end with "Signal Strength: 76%"
Live: the RSSI drops to -90 dBm and the row updates to 20% (left); BlueZ drops the RSSI and the row disappears (right)
